name: 85°C Bakery Cafe-National City
notes: Restaurant's own site (85cbakerycafe.com/menu/) has no per-item prices (page is promotional/photo-only; the only 3 '$' matches on the page were a coupon promo, not menu pricing). Fell back to the National City-specific DoorDash storefront (store id 467975), confirmed to match this exact branch via FAQ JSON-LD giving address '1302 E Plaza Blvd #103, National City, CA 91950' (matches batch address exactly; other 85C DoorDash listings for Hacienda Heights/Anaheim/LA/Alhambra branches were excluded). schema.org Menu JSON-LD gave 76 raw rows across 13 sections; dropped the 'Most Ordered' section (12 items, all duplicates of items already listed under their real category) and 'MERCHANDISE' (1 non-food tote bag item), leaving 63 unique priced food/drink items across 12 categories (Sea Salt Series, Espresso, Milk Teas, Fresh Teas, Specialties, Blended Drinks, Bottled Drinks, 8" Cake, Top 15 Breads, Box Sets, Rolls). Prices are non-round (e.g. $4.90, $6.77, $41.80) typical of DoorDash markup; no consistent divisor in the 1.00-1.35 sweep resolved them to clean menu prices, so used as-observed rather than guessing a correction.

name: El Super
notes: El Super is a Mexican-style grocery supermarket chain, not a restaurant with a discrete priced dish menu. Its own site (elsupermarkets.com) publishes only weekly-ad grocery item prices (e.g. tortillas, chuck steak) and a store locator; the Oceanside location page (locations.elsupermarkets.com/ca-oceanside-045-000) returned a Fastly TLS/SNI routing error and could not be loaded directly, but the current store info was confirmed via elsupermarkets.com/store/oceanside/ (1527 Mission Ave, Oceanside, CA 92058 - matches batch address, 92057/92058 zip discrepancy is the same store per phone number 760-681-5130). Some El Super stores have an attached 'El Super Restaurant' hot-food counter (seen on elsupermarkets.com/restaurant-locations/ store-locator filter) but no priced menu for it is published anywhere. DoorDash (el-super-oceanside-25608494) and Uber Eats listings for this store show packaged grocery items (chip bags, tortillas, snack packs) with grocery pricing, not discrete restaurant dishes. Yelp's 'Our New Menu' photo caption is not an itemized price list. No usable dish/price data exists online for this location; blocking rather than filing grocery SKUs as dishes.

name: Sally's Waterfront Dining
blocked: bot wall on the only source with confirmed prices
notes: Own site (sallyssandiego.com/menus, /menus-1, /menus/beverage) embeds its menu via a SinglePlatform widget (data-location=sallys). Fetched the widget's rendered output directly (places.singleplatform.com/sallys/menu_widget) for both the default food menu and the beverage/wine menu (display_menu=4557496) - both returned real dish/wine names (Coastal Chowder, Deconstructed Cobb Salad, burgers, Grilled Shrimp, wine list, beer flight, etc.) but NO prices anywhere in either payload, even with hide_price=false forced. OpenTable's own listing (opentable.com/r/sallys-waterfront-dining-san-diego) surfaced real priced items in its search snippet (Cheese & Garlic Focaccia $10.00, Parmesan Truffle French Fries $10.00, Charred Spanish Octopus $22.00, Crab Cake $24.00) confirming a real priced menu exists, but the page itself refused the connection (curl exit 56 / connection reset) on repeated attempts with standard and navigation headers - a bot wall, not a missing menu. Not filing dishes from the search-snippet fragment alone since it is a partial, uncontrolled excerpt. An Uber Eats listing for 'Sally's Restaurant and Grill' was found but not used - name and likely location do not match this Market Place/Hyatt property closely enough to trust without an address check, and time budget did not allow verifying it separately.

name: Miss Kim's by That Boy Good
notes: Permanently closed and replaced. The operator's own Instagram (@thatboygood_bbq) posted 'PERMANENTLY CLOSED - the final day That Boy Good will ever be open!' for the 207 N Coast Hwy, Oceanside location. Yelp's listing title for this address now reads 'CLOSED'. The address is now occupied by a different, unrelated business: Eat Crispy Burger opened its third location at 207 N Coast Hwy, Oceanside (confirmed via eatcrispyburger.com's own locations list, Grubhub, and local business-news coverage dated 2026). Filing as not_found (permanent) per positive proof of closure and replacement, not blocked.

name: IceChurro
notes: Own site (icechurro.com) is a Next.js ordering app whose menu is loaded client-side via JS after page load; static fetch of the homepage and the /m/icechurro/icechurro-belmont order page (which the embedded JSON-LD confirms is this exact 3146 Mission Blvd, San Diego location) returned no priced items in the raw HTML. Fell back to DoorDash (store id 33674817), confirmed via its FAQ JSON-LD to match this address exactly (3146 Mission Blvd, San Diego CA 92109). schema.org Menu JSON-LD gave 47 raw rows across 10 sections; dropped 'Most Ordered' (12 items, all duplicates of items under their real category), leaving 35 unique priced items across 9 categories (Ice Churro, Churros, Loaded Churros, Jolly Rancher Slush, Aguas Fresca, Side Dips, Milkshakes, Hot Drinks, Cold Drinks). Row count matched exactly (12+5+5+3+4+3+4+7+3+1=47) confirming no truncation. Prices are non-round DoorDash-typical values; the 1.00-1.35 divisor sweep found no consistent factor resolving them to clean menu prices, so used as-observed.

name: An's Dry Cleaning
notes: Identity check: 'An's Dry Cleaning' is the real, intentional name of a gelato shop at 3017 Adams Ave, San Diego (a well-known North Park novelty-named business, confirmed via USA Today 10Best, NBC San Diego, TripAdvisor, and Instagram @ansgelato - 'THIS DRY CLEANER ACTUALLY SERVES GELATO'), not a misfiled dry-cleaning business - website adcgelato.com is theirs. Their own site's menu pages (adcgelato.com/our-menu, /gelato-menu) list no prices (the in-store scoop/cup/cone menu is only shown via an Instagram Highlights story, not text). Found their first-party Toast Online Ordering storefront (order.toasttab.com/online/ans-dry-cleaning), server-rendered HTML confirmed address 3017 Adams Ave and phone (619) 450-6166 match exactly. It sells 8 named gelato pint flavors (their quirky dry-cleaning-themed names: Moyozashi, Fleece, Coppola, Jusi, Palate Cleanser, Pienfu, Lustring, Hampton) all at $13.50/pint, plus a Merchandise section (2 t-shirts, $35.00 each) which was dropped as non-food. Filed the 8 pint flavors as dishes; note these are takeaway-pint prices, not necessarily the same as any in-store single-scoop/cup pricing which isn't published anywhere in text form.

name: Blue Water Seafood Ocean Beach
notes: Own site (sdbluewater.com) menu pages are client-rendered with no prices in raw HTML; embedded SpotHopper/spotapps ordering widget (tmt.spotapps.co/ordering-menu/?spot_id=56628) has real dish names in a Nuxt.js state blob but no extractable price field. Found first-party Toast Online Ordering storefront (order.toasttab.com/online/bluewateroceanbeach), address confirmed as 5083 Santa Monica Ave #1B, San Diego, CA 92107 (batch lists 'Ste 2B' - same street address/suite, treating as the same location; #1B appears on the page's own FAQ/location schema). Page embeds a full Apollo/GraphQL menu cache (380 raw MenuItem records across 25 groups) rather than plain server-rendered price spans, which is why the naive data-testid price-span regex used for restaurant 9 only matched once. Excluded the 'A La Carte' section (20 build-your-own fish items, each with 3-4 unlabeled tiered prices with no portion/size labels present anywhere in the page data - listing any one price would misrepresent the real cost) and 2 'Soups' items with the same unlabeled multi-tier issue (Clam Chowder, Hearty Seafood - cup/bowl sizes not labeled). Also dropped 5 items with a $0 placeholder price (divider rows / an out-of-stock item with no real price). Kept 353 single-priced items across the remaining 22 groups (food: Appetizers, Kid's Menu, Plates, Raw Appetizers, Salad, Sandwich, Sashimi Appetizers, Sauces, Sautes, Soups, Specialties, Specialty Tacos, Tacos, Happy Hour; drinks: Cocktails, Draft Beer, Wine by the Glass/Bottle, N/A Drinks, Mixed Drinks, Bottle Beer & Cans, Sake Bottle, Mocktail N/A). Sample prices (Calamari Plate $25.95, Grilled Shrimp Plate $28.95, Jumbo Shrimp Plate $35.00) match the independent Serper search snippet exactly, confirming the data is live and accurate.
